content.text: Many creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh face the challenge of getting paid for their digital work due to platform restrictions and high fees. The likes of Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted in these regions, forcing creators to find alternative solutions. This guide is designed to help you set up a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] digital commerce stack that allows you to receive USDT [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-minimum-viable-stack|Payment Methods]]-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-4|payment]]s for your digital products, without relying on restricted platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The reason this infrastructure works when platforms fail is that it's built on free and open-source tools that give you full control over your payment and delivery pipeline. By using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you can create a stack that is not dependent on any single platform or country. This means you can receive USDT payments for your digital products, without worrying about platform restrictions or high fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to prepare a few things. First, you'll need to sign up for an account on NOWPayments, which will provide you with the necessary API keys and credentials to integrate with your stack. You'll also need to set up a Tron or Solana wallet, as these blockchains have low transaction fees and fast settlement speeds. Additionally, you'll need to create a digital product or service to sell, and a sales page to promote it.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your stack. This involves setting up a webhook to receive payment notifications, and configuring your delivery pipeline to automatically send products to customers upon payment confirmation. You can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle this integration, and Supabase to store order information. Once set up, you can test your pipeline by making a payment through NOWPayments.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction in network fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you're ready to go live. Simply promote your sales page to potential customers, and wait for them to make a payment. When a payment is received, your stack will automatically process the transaction, send the product to the customer, and store the order information in Supabase. You can track your transactions and sales through the NOWPayments dashboard, and adjust your pricing and product offerings as needed.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital commerce stack grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and transactions. To do this, you can upgrade your NOWPayments plan to include more features and support, and add more nodes to your stack to handle increased load. You can also use the Complete Builder Kit to create more blueprints and templates for your stack, and leverage the expertise of the COREMERCH community to optimize your infrastructure for performance and security.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

The most important question a reader would ask is: How long does it take to receive USDT payments for my digital products? The answer is: it takes under 10 seconds for payments to be confirmed on the Tron or Solana blockchain, and under 1 minute for payments to be settled in USDT. This is much faster than traditional payment platforms like PayPal, which can take days or even weeks to process payments.
Solana transaction fees average fractions of a cent per transaction.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more resources to help you build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, be sure to check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at COREMERCH. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to create a fully-featured digital commerce stack, and is available for instant download. Additionally, you can shop for other products and services at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Create a NOWPayments account and set up a Tron or Solana wallet, Integrate NOWPayments with your stack using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, Configure your delivery pipeline to automatically send products to customers upon payment confirmation, Test your pipeline by making a payment through NOWPayments, Go live and promote your sales page to potential customers, Track your transactions and sales through the NOWPayments dashboard, and adjust your pricing and product offerings as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a Tron or Solana wallet?
You can set up a Tron or Solana wallet using a third-party service like MetaMask or Trust Wallet, or by using a native wallet on the Tron or Solana blockchain.
What are the transaction fees for USDT payments on Tron and Solana?
Transaction fees for USDT payments on Tron and Solana are under $0.10 per transaction, making them a cost-effective option for digital creators.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my stack?

You can integrate NOWPayments with your stack using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and configure your delivery pipeline to automatically send products to customers upon payment confirmation.
How do I track my transactions and sales?
You can track your transactions and sales through the NOWPayments dashboard, and adjust your pricing and product offerings as needed.
Can I use other cryptocurrencies besides USDT?
Yes, you can use other cryptocurrencies supported by NOWPayments, such as BTC, ETH, and more.
